name: marketplace-catalog
description: Catalog API actions allow you to manage your entities through list, describe, and update capabilities.

subcommands.name: batch-describe-entities
subcommands.description: Returns metadata and content for multiple entities.

subcommands.name: cancel-change-set
subcommands.description: Used to cancel an open change request.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource-based policy on an entity that is identified by its resource ARN.

subcommands.name: describe-change-set
subcommands.description: Provides information about a given change set.

subcommands.name: describe-entity
subcommands.description: Returns the metadata and content of the entity.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Gets a resource-based policy of an entity that is identified by its resource ARN.

subcommands.name: list-change-sets
subcommands.description: Returns the list of change sets owned by the account being used to make the call.

subcommands.name: list-entities
subcommands.description: Provides the list of entities of a given type.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags that have been added to a resource (either an entity or change set).

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a resource-based policy to an entity.

subcommands.name: start-change-set
subcommands.description: Allows you to request changes for your entities.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags a resource (either an entity or change set).

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag or list of tags from a resource (either an entity or change set).
